text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. First, make a clear plan and decide how much time each task needs. Then focus on prioritization: finish the most important work first, not just the easiest. Scope management also matters. If a task is too big, reduce it to what is really necessary. Finally, communication is essential. Tell your teacher, boss, or team early if you have a problem, instead of waiting until the last minute. When you plan carefully, choose your priorities, control the size of the work, and speak openly with others, deadlines become much easier to handle.
